snippet.title: Circulo – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter the geometric chaos.

Circulo is a fast-paced 2D arena survival game where every run becomes more intense. Fight endless waves of enemies, upgrade your build, unlock new forms and abilities, and face powerful bosses.

Coming this summer.
